name: com.yariinfotech/server
description: Model Context Protocol interface for Yari Infotech engineering & architectural advisory.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Use when you need to inspect Yari Infotech's 12 digital engineering services across Build. Connect. and Grow. pillars. Returns a JSON array of service slugs, titles, pillars, summaries, and canonical URLs.

pillar.description: Filter services by strategic pillar: 'build', 'connect', 'grow', or 'all' to retrieve every capability.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Use when you need verified Yari Infotech engineering case studies, architecture decisions, and measured business outcomes. Returns public project slugs, industries, summaries, metrics, and canonical URLs.

industry.description: Optional industry keyword filter such as 'hospitality', 'commerce', 'logistics', or 'growing-businesses'. Omit to list all public case studies.

tools.name: estimate_project
tools.description: Use when a user or agent needs an indicative engineering timeline, starting price tier, and direct estimator URL for scoping a website, mobile app, custom software, or AI automation project.

serviceSlug.description: Optional canonical service slug such as 'websites', 'applications', 'custom-software', or 'ai-automation'.

scale.description: Project complexity tier: 'starter' (1-3 weeks), 'growth' (4-6 weeks), or 'comprehensive' (6-12 weeks).

tools.name: create_readiness_audit
tools.description: Use when a user or agent wants to queue a digital readiness and AI performance audit for a target website URL. Returns a jobId, queued status, polling statusUrl, and interactive auditUrl.
